name: Zoning & Land Use
description: Complaints may include unpermitted short-term rentals, home-based businesses operating without required approvals, or commercial activity in zones where it is not permitted. NOTE: Do not include personal info in the Description field.

name: Substandard Housing
description: Complaints may include inadequate heating, plumbing, or electrical conditions; the presence of mold, lead, or asbestos; pest infestations; structural hazards (such as failing floors or stairways); or landlords failing to make required repairs in occupied units. NOTE: Do not include personal info in the Description field.

name: Construction Activity (Private Property)
description:
Complaints may include unpermitted construction or demolition, work exceeding an approved permit scope, construction outside of allowed hours (8 AM–6 PM Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM Saturday; no work permitted on Sundays or holidays), or unsafe/exposed hazards. NOTE: Do not include personal info in the Description field.

For after-hours complaints, contact the non-emergency police line at (650) ...

name: Gas-Powered Leaf Blowers
description:
Complaints may include the use of gas-powered leaf blowers on residential property by owners, occupants, or landscaping crews. The City does not currently regulate gas-powered leaf blower use on non-residential properties.

Please be sure to include the specific location, time of occurrence, and day of the week in your report. 

NOTE: Do not include personal info in the Description field.

description: Use this request ONLY to report table and chairs in the public right-of-way that may be a permitting issue. This request will be routed to Public Works Engineering Services staff, who are responsible for reviewing work in the public right-of-way. NOTE: Do not include personal info in the Description field.

name: Other Request
description: For other community inquiries, please share specific details about what you are reporting including a short description of the issue, location, and contact information should we have follow-up questions. Otherwise, please email the City at  City at CityMgr@paloalto.gov or call us at 650-329-2100. Thank you.
